entities.summary: Francisco Cerúndolo is an Argentine professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 18 achieved on 5 May 2025 and a best doubles ranking of No. 203 reached on 31 October 2022. He is the current No. 1 singles player from Argentina and South America.
